tests.name: callModel request shape posts to the chat completions endpoint with generous max_tokens
callModel request shape sends the configured temperature — not a hardcoded value
callModel request shape sends temperature 0 when explicitly overridden to 0
callModel request shape serializes assistant tool_calls to the wire format with stringified arguments
callModel request shape sends an abort signal so a hung server cannot block until the test timeout
callModel request shape includes tools in the request when provided
callModel request shape uses WEAVER_EVAL_BASE_URL and WEAVER_EVAL_MODEL when set
callModel request shape sends Authorization header when apiKey is set in config
callModel request shape omits Authorization header when apiKey is not set
callModel request shape picks up apiKey from WEAVER_EVAL_API_KEY env var
callModel request shape uses an explicitly passed config over the env-derived default
callModel request shape uses WEAVER_EVAL_MODEL when set
callModel response parsing returns tool calls with parsed arguments from the assistant message
callModel response parsing returns multiple tool calls when the model emits more than one
callModel response parsing returns empty toolCalls and the text content when no tool is called
callModel response parsing marks a tool call with malformed JSON arguments instead of throwing
callModel response parsing leaves invalidArguments unset when arguments parse cleanly
